test_title: PYST 47: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means ‘P is the mother of Q’,

P # Q means ‘P is the wife of Q’,

P & Q means ‘P is the brother of Q’,

P % Q means ‘P is the father of Q’.

How is I related to M if ‘I # J % B & L + M’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Symbol → + | # | & | %

Meaning → Mother | Wife | Brother | Father

Given: I # J % B & L + M

It means: I is the wife of J, J is the father of B, B is the brother of L, and L is the mother of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b01e8f8ff75482d2e10d24ce461b838ae319a2ec6c16188af27d4b3a75437158.png] 

Thus, I is the Mother's mother of M.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
